g.title: finding
g.text: Custom projected gated GEMM appears as hot TK kernel:
~1.514 ms over 72 calls in short profiler run.
ptxas reports 24-28 B spills for gated_linear_template.
Epilogue-visible path removes that kernel and lets cuBLAS/NVJET own GEMM.
